description.narrative: The energy consumption of the plant per cubic meter of desalinated water produced is a measure of energy efficiency of the plant. A higher kW value per cubic meter indicated lower energy efficiency and consequently , a higher cost of water production and vice versa.

comment.narrative: The baseline value of 3.8kWm3 is the average energy efficiency of the first phase of the Southern Gaza Desalination Plant fully commissioned in September 2017
The target value of 4kWm3 is the expected energy efficiency of the completed plant and is in line with international standards for such technologies.

title.narrative: Levels of chloride are within the permissible limits

description.narrative: An indicator of the quality of water based on WHO standards. It indicates the proportion of salt removed from the sea water during the desalination process. The indicator value (measured in parts per million or mg/l) shows the concentration of salt in drinking water and shows how effective the desalination process is, and the overall quality of distributed water after blending (mixing desalinated water with water from other sources).

comment.narrative: The baseline value of 350ppm represents the average chloride concentration of distributed water from the first phase of the Southern Gaza Desalination Plant fully commissioned in September 2017

The target value of 250 parts per million ppm represents the average chloride concentration of distributed water after completion of Phase 2 and Phase 3 of the Southern Gaza Desalination Plant in December 2022. It is expected that by increasing the blending ratio of desalinated water to that from other sources the level of chloride will be decreased to 250ppm.

title.narrative: Level of Nitrate are within the permissible limits

description.narrative: An indicator of the quality of water based on WHO standards. It indicates the level of contamination from nitrates (especially sewage) in drinking water. The indicator value (measured in parts per million or mg/l) shows the overall quality of distributed water after blending (mixing desalinated water with water from other sources).

comment.narrative: The baseline value of 350ppm represents the average nitrate concentration of distributed water from the first phase of the Southern Gaza Desalination Plant fully commissioned in September 2017

The target value of 50 parts per million ppm represents the average nitrate concentration of distributed water after completion of Phase 2 and Phase 3 of the Southern Gaza Desalination Plant in December 2022. It is expected that by increasing the blending ratio of desalinated water to that from other sources the level of nitrates will be decreased to 50ppm.
